summary: Reorders samples inside input channels by increasing values, decreasing values, or random order, optionally creating an index channel.

key_params.name: method
key_params.note: Increasing values, decreasing values, or random

key_params.name: select
key_params.note: Select sort reference by channel indices or names

key_concepts: Sort CHOP reorders samples inside channels by increasing values, decreasing values, or random order.
Sorting by a selected channel makes all other channels follow that selected channel's new sample order.
If no selected sort channel is specified, channels are sorted independently.
Index Channel records the former sample indices before sorting.
Sort CHOP does not change channel order relative to other channels; use Reorder CHOP for that.
common_gotchas: Sort CHOP reorders samples inside channels, not the order of channels relative to each other.
When a sort channel is specified, all other channels follow that channel's new sample order.
Leaving the selection empty sorts all channels independently.
Enable Index Channel when downstream logic needs to restore or inspect original sample positions.
Use Reorder CHOP to sort or rearrange channel order.
